Schnittstelle Provider<A>

Typparameter:
A - the provided value type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Appliable<Provider.µ, A>, Applicable<Nothing,A>, Bindable<Provider.µ, A>, Fun<Nothing,A>, Function<Nothing,A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Provider.µ, A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Provider.µ>, Mappable<Provider.µ, A>, Monadic<Provider.µ, A>, Supplier<A>, Transmogrifyable<Provider<A>>, Unwindable<Provider<A>>, Value<A>
Funktionsschnittstelle:
Dies ist eine funktionale Schnittstelle, die somit als Zuweisungsziel für einen Lambdaausdruck oder eine Methodenreferenz verwendet werden kann.
@FunctionalInterface public interface Provider<A> extends Monadic<Provider.µ, A>, Unwindable<Provider<A>>, Transmogrifyable<Provider<A>>, Fun<Nothing,A>, Value<A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Provider.µ, A>

The Provider interface represents a functional type that yields a value of type A and exposes a focused set of functional programming utilities.

It combines traits typically associated with functors and monads to offer a versatile API for providing and transforming values. As a functional interface, Provider can be used directly with lambdas or method references. Common use cases include value encapsulation, lazy evaluation, and reusable transformations in a functional style.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null.

Features

  • Implements Supplier to provide values.
  • Supports monadic operations such as map, applyTo, and flatMap.
  • Integrates with Fun, Value, and Higher1.
  • Provides extras like unwind, and transmogrify.
